scenes.headline: “We patched it, so we're safe.” Not quite.
scenes.say: IT teams: patching this bug was not enough. Here are three myths about the BeyondTrust zero-day, and the facts that bust them.

scenes.headline: The tool help desks use to take over your PC
scenes.body: A flaw let remote attackers skip the login entirely
scenes.say: BeyondTrust Remote Support is the software help desks use to take control of a computer and fix it. A flaw in it let remote attackers skip the login entirely.

scenes.headline: Critical severity (CVSS 4.0)
scenes.source: BeyondTrust via Rapid7 · Canadian Cyber Centre
scenes.say: BeyondTrust rates it nine point three out of ten, critical. It affects Remote Support version twenty-six point two point three and earlier.

scenes.headline: “If it's not public, no one is using it.”
scenes.say: Myth one: if a bug is not public yet, nobody is using it.

scenes.headline: Exploited for weeks before disclosure
scenes.source: BeyondTrust via Rapid7 · Canadian Cyber Centre · CISA KEV
scenes.say: Fact: the first known compromises date to August twenty-ninth. BeyondTrust contained one on September twenty-eighth, patched its cloud customers by October ninth, went public on the fifteenth, and the US agency CISA flagged it as exploited on the sixteenth.

scenes.headline: “Once you patch, you're safe.”
scenes.say: Myth two: once you patch, you are safe.

scenes.headline: Patching does not remove persistence.
scenes.say: Fact: as Rapid7 puts it, patching does not remove persistence. Anything the attackers left behind is still there.

scenes.headline: Web shell. Root access. The credential vault.
scenes.body: Mandiant links it to a suspected China-nexus espionage group it calls Armory Castle
scenes.say: Mandiant, part of Google, says the attackers planted a web shell, took root control, tried to pull credentials from the vault, and set up ways to stay in. It links them to a suspected China-nexus espionage group it calls Armory Castle.

scenes.headline: “No alerts means no intruders.”
scenes.say: Myth three: no alerts means no intruders.

scenes.headline: An absence of known indicators does not establish that an appliance is uncompromised.
scenes.say: Fact: the attackers deleted logs. BeyondTrust itself warns: an absence of known indicators does not establish that an appliance is uncompromised.

scenes.headline: The tools that hold the keys are the best front door.
scenes.body: Limit who can reach them, and keep their logs somewhere attackers can't erase.
scenes.say: Analyst note: the tools that hold the keys are the best front door. Limit who can reach them, and keep their logs somewhere attackers cannot erase.

scenes.headline: If your company runs it
items: Hunt for compromise, even after patching
Send its logs to an outside system
scenes.say: If your company runs it, do this today. Patch self-hosted servers. Hunt for signs of compromise, even after patching. Rotate the passwords it stores. And send its logs to an outside system.
